offering_description.value: Supplies ambulatory infusion pumps and related services for outpatient cancer treatment and post-surgical pain management, and provides negative-pressure wound therapy equipment. It works with care providers to get pumps to patients for use at home and handles billing. It also sells, rents, refurbishes and repairs medical equipment for healthcare providers.

primary_products.value: New and refurbished infusion pumps; infusion sets and accessories; negative-pressure wound therapy pumps and supplies

primary_services.value: Home infusion pump coordination and patient support; medical equipment rental; biomedical inspection and preventive maintenance; medical equipment repair and refurbishment

customer_segment.value: B2B: Oncology practices, hospitals, surgery centers, home infusion providers and other medical equipment suppliers; B2C: Patients using prescribed pumps for treatment at home

end_markets.value: Outpatient oncology; post-surgical pain management; home infusion; wound care; hospital and outpatient care

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Insurer and government health plan payments for prescribed pumps and related supplies used at home; rental or leasing: Infusion pumps and other medical equipment rented to healthcare providers; product sales: New and refurbished medical equipment and disposable supplies; service fees: Biomedical equipment inspection, preventive maintenance and repair
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Coordinates prescribed pump use for patients and maintains medical equipment for healthcare providers; asset operator: Owns and maintains a fleet of infusion pumps supplied to patients and healthcare facilities; distributor: Sources pumps and supplies from manufacturers and sells them to healthcare providers

geography_served.value: North America: Primarily the United States, with medical equipment operations in Canada

specialization.value: related lines: Patient infusion pump services, wound therapy equipment, medical equipment sales and rental, and biomedical servicing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales and rental relationships with healthcare facilities and home infusion providers; partners / resellers: Clinics and surgical teams that arrange prescribed pump access for patients

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Medicare accreditation and supplier standards for durable medical equipment, plus applicable state licensing

notes: The current scope of its wound care line is uncertain.
